title: Bug: cannot create new item from webui
description: Two related bugs: (1) Creating a new item from the web UI silently fails — the server returns 200 OK but the create_idea WebSocket message never results in a file being created by the pipeline, even when the pipeline is connected. (2) The board field in the New Idea modal on the per-client (client.html) page is a free-text input instead of a <select> populated with available boards — the dashboard index.html already does this correctly.
plan:
Plan complete. Here's a summary of the two bugs and fixes:

**Bug 1 - create_idea silently fails:** The `_handle_create_idea` callback in `tui.py` uses `call_from_thread()` but is invoked from within the Textual asyncio event loop (via `_handle_incoming` in the reconnect loop). `call_from_thread` is designed for cross-thread calls, not same-thread. Fix: make the callback async and `await` it, matching the pattern used by `_handle_server_answers`.

**Bug 2 - Board field is free-text in client.html:** The New Idea modal in `client.html:305` uses `<input type="text">` instead of a `<select>` dropdown. Additionally, `serveClientPage` in `api.go` doesn't pass a `Boards` list to the template. Fix: add `Boards` to the template data and replace the input with a `<select>` populated via `{{range .Boards}}`.
